summary: V13.0 full validation — SEO (robots, 3 sitemaps), unified /auth page (signup+signin), redirects /login→/auth?mode=signin and /register→/auth?mode=signup, owner+new-user auth, /gaze-naturale public, /admin/users owner access, 14 pricing plans, Stripe LIVE checkout returns cs_live_* URLs, donations 5 EUR + rejection <min, /api/plans catalog, /api/me/plan quotas. 19/19 pytest PASS. Frontend UI validated on desktop 1920x1080: Auth title toggles correctly, GDPR checkbox on signup, GoogleLogin button rendered (with expected 403 on preview origin), fonts Cabinet Grotesk H1 / Satoshi body, .epd-btn bgcolor rgb(9,9,11) = zinc-950 (no gradient violet), global-translator-toggle opens dropdown with 25+ languages. After scroll to trigger lazy-load: 90/93 images load (3 minor secondary-service tiles broken).

ui_bugs.issue: Header nav wraps oddly at 1920px: 'Gaze Naturale' link visually splits the 'Energy Project Design' logo text across two lines, and 'Investitori' overlaps 'Transparența'. Design/spacing issue — not blocking functionality.
Language options have no data-testid (e.g. lang-option-en). Dropdown IS functional and lists 25+ languages, but automated cookie-switch tests (RO→EN→FR→RO) can't target items by testid.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows '[GSI_LOGGER]: The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID' + 403 on the preview URL. Expected behavior for preview — production origin (www.energyprojectdesign.com) must be whitelisted in Google Cloud OAuth Client. Email/password auth works perfectly.
GSI warns 'Provided button width is invalid: 100%'. Should pass a numeric px value (e.g. width="320") instead of "100%". Cosmetic only — button still renders full width via container CSS.

issues: 3 Unsplash image URLs return 0 naturalWidth: photo-1605618826115-fb9e0c93a6cb (Spălătorii auto), photo-1567542495143-72eabec5ce6d (Transport naval), photo-1571266028243-e4bb35f9f38f (DJ/foto/IT). Replace with working Unsplash IDs in /app/frontend/src/data/services.js.

critical_code_review_comments: Auth.jsx clean: correct data-testid coverage (auth-title, email-input, password-input, name-input, gdpr-consent, gdpr-error, register-submit, login-submit, switch-to-signin, switch-to-signup, google-auth-wrapper). Signup requires gdpr checked + password >=6 chars. Mode toggling via useSearchParams is idempotent.

App.js: React Router <Navigate> for /login and /register is CLIENT-SIDE only — first request returns SPA HTML with status 200, then JS mutates URL. This is standard SPA behavior and matches the review-request expectation of 'status 200 final'.
server.py native /api/auth/google endpoint verifies Google ID token against GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID env — correct. Returns EPD JWT + user. Idempotent user creation. Uses _is_developer_email() consistently.

server.py Stripe donations: min 2 RON / 1 EUR limits enforced. Donor message forwarded to support@ + thank-you email queued (best-effort, wrapped in try/except so email failure does not block Stripe session).
admin_routes.py /api/admin/users properly guarded by get_admin_user dep (403 for non-admin). Exports CSV, plan-change, delete all present.
server.py > 3400 lines — refactor recommended but not blocking. Consider splitting auth/payments/documents into separate routers.

Preview STRIPE_API_KEY is sk_live_* — every /api/payments/checkout and /api/donations/checkout call creates a real Stripe session (cs_live_*). Testing agents MUST NOT complete payment (URL is only inspected, not visited).
